entities.name: PMID:14653591
observations: Meek et al. followed 107 revision TKA patients (57 standard medial parapatellar, 50 rectus snip; minimum follow-up two years). WOMAC function, pain, stiffness, satisfaction showed no statistically significant between-group differences; authors concluded rectus snip did not affect outcome.

entities.name: Rectus snip outcomes
observations: Comparative revision TKA study found no statistically significant WOMAC function, pain, stiffness, or satisfaction difference for rectus snip versus standard medial parapatellar approach; overall outcome was unaffected.
